svg.text: PR #1951 Scheduler Timeline: Link Loss & Recovery (Before vs. After)
Horizontal swimlanes paired with 00-scheduler-overview-before-after.svg. Non-linear time axis: "//" marks a compressed ~1 s wait (hang timer / mempool park).
Panel A — BEFORE (base 15e2f411): Link Loss Stalls Rings, Trips 1 s Hang Timer & Kills Session (-EBUSY)
Link DOWN (cable loss / E610 4.7 s autoneg) — NIC TX ring stops completing descriptors
Sleeps on 6 s EAL alarm doing nothing (no link poll, no atomic link_down flag; datapath is blind)
SW ring full -> builder stalls; tv_frames_out_hang() fires
mt_txq_burst() == 0; 1 s hang timer runs during link down
Expires at t=1.05 s -> sets tx_queue_recovery_pending[s_port]=true
Dead NIC TX ring holds mbufs & single frame->sh_info in DMA
No sh_info retirement, no mempool parking, no RTCP FIFO reset
Failure mode: 1 s hang fires at t=1.05 s while link is down -> st20_tx_queue_fatal_error() zeroes sh_info refcnt (DMA UAF), fails -EBUSY, sets s->active=false.
Panel B — AFTER (c5f235c3): 100 ms Link Poll, Paced Drop, Drain/Resync & Non-Fatal Mempool Renew
Link DOWN (50 ms .. 350 ms) — port carrier lost
Link UP at t=350 ms (live ring drains; wedged E610 ring waits for queue swap)
Zero PMD calls on datapath lcore (atomic read only)
Held DMA frames stay pinned (zero UAF)
RTCP FIFO reset -> no seq-gap flood
Old mbufs stay pinned in DMA
Result: Link drops are absorbed without tripping TX hang; live rings resume cleanly at pkt 0, and wedged E610 rings recover via parked mempool renew + 1 s reap.
